description: This file contains utility functions for interacting with the app deployments API, including fetching project names by project ID, normalizing deployment statuses, aggregating deployment counts by status, and fetching deployment status counts with server and client-side fallbacks.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameByProjectId
methods.description: Fetches a project name given a project ID by querying the deployments API with a filter.

methods.name: normalizeStatusDynamic
methods.description: Converts raw status input into a human-readable label, defaulting to 'Unknown' for undefined or null inputs.

methods.name: aggregateCountsDynamic
methods.description: Aggregates deployment records into counts grouped by normalized status, sorted by count descending and status ascending.

methods.name: fetchStatusCountsClientSide
methods.description: Fetches deployment data in pages and aggregates counts client-side, with configurable page size and max pages.

methods.name: fetchDeploymentStatusCounts
methods.description: Fetches deployment status counts from server with optional fallback to client-side aggregation.
